items.title: Costco Stock: Earnings Growth Could Shape the Next Big Move
items.summary: Six straight earnings beats have pushed Costco shares up 20% this year, yet a 49x trailing P/E leaves little room for error. One metric could decide whether the rally keeps running or finally stalls.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on DoorDash Stock?

items.title: Why Is DoorDash (DASH) Pairing A New Membership With $12 Meal Boxes?
items.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) and Lyft have introduced Lyft Go, a joint membership that bundles rideshare and food delivery perks for subscribers. The partners are offering Lyft Go as a single integrated plan, aiming to combine regular ride usage with recurring DoorDash orders under one subscription. DoorDash has launched $12 Meal Boxes with no delivery fees in more than 20 U.S. cities, targeting budget conscious diners. The Lyft Go tie up and $12 Meal Boxes are only one part of the broader story...

items.title: Amazon switches to Uber Eats for restaurant delivery perks
